english.description: "Is that the result you wanted, Thomas?"
english.name: ACH_5

english.description: "Maybe this is a punishment from the Father of the Forest."
english.name: ACH_6

english.description: "As I said, I want to be the real winner in the end."
english.name: ACH_8

english.description: "The one thing we need is stuck in the prison's storeroom."
english.name: ACH_11

english.description: "Good thing you ain't dead, or the shit would really hit the fan."
english.name: ACH_13

english.description: "It's just an ordinary business card... although it seems they offer more than just drinks."
english.name: ACH_15

english.description: "Warning, a prisoner has escaped! I repeat, a prisoner has escaped!"
english.name: ACH_17

english.description: "I sure wish I could turn into a bird."
english.name: ACH_18

english.description: "But the light up ahead is still there; I can't be hallucinating now..."
english.name: ACH_19

english.description: "There'll always be unfortunate people in this world. It's either them or us."
english.name: ACH_22

english.description: "Could it be that the urban legend isn't just a crazy story?"
english.name: ACH_2

english.description: "The power of my fists is only superficial. My strength comes from within... I'm not fighting alone."
english.name: ACH_9

english.description: "It was love at first sight, until the day you left."
english.name: ACH_7

english.description: "Throw yourself into the darkness and disappear into the sunlight."
english.name: ACH_20

english.description: "We agreed it'd only be for three years, but it's been three, then three more..."
english.name: ACH_102

english.description: "Fenrir... I've finally found where you're hiding. So next, I have to figure out a way to get there..."
english.name: ACH_104

english.description: "I hope this doesn't turn out to be a dumb idea. I don't have time to make a life ring."
english.name: ACH_105

english.description: "Now it's sunrise! You've transformed from a rock back into yourself!"
english.name: ACH_106

english.description: "Oh boy... Talking to you is always such a pleasure!"
english.name: ACH_107

english.description: "... Yeah, I'm the 'Fenrir' you're looking for."
english.name: ACH_108

english.description: "... I've never been anything but a patriot."
english.name: ACH_109

english.description: "I promised I'd get you out. And I never break a promise."
english.name: ACH_110

english.description: "Since they called me 'Fenrir'... I think it's time for me to break free."
english.name: ACH_111

english.description: "It's moonlight at the end of the pipe. We're almost there."
english.name: ACH_113

english.description: "You can open your eyes. I think you'll like the view."
english.name: ACH_114

english.description: "I see. Something of a fish whisper."
english.name: ACH_115

english.description: "Don't worry, we felines are naturally good at climbing."
english.name: ACH_116

english.description: "At least today, I can help a good guy and then catch a bad guy."
english.name: ACH_118

english.description: "A fist-shaped trophy... It might be good for cracking acorns. Sadly there aren't any oak trees in prison."
english.name: ACH_121

english.description: "Judging by the length, thickness, and hardness, it must be wolf hair."
english.name: ACH_122

schinese.description: “再累都没法休息，这份钱可没那么好赚呐~喵~”
schinese.name: ACH_4

schinese.description: “这是你想要看到的结果吗，托马斯？”
schinese.name: ACH_5

schinese.description: “或许这是‘森林之父'对我的一种惩罚吧。”
schinese.name: ACH_6

schinese.description: “我说过，我要成为的可是最后真正的赢家。”
schinese.name: ACH_8

schinese.description: “宝藏就静静的躺在监狱仓库这艘‘沉船'里。”
schinese.name: ACH_11

schinese.description: “~没死就好，否则就又是大麻烦了~”
schinese.name: ACH_13

schinese.description: “这怎么看都只是一张普通的小广告而已…虽然上面的确有一些勾人的东西。”
schinese.name: ACH_15

schinese.description: “警报~有囚犯越狱！重复~有囚犯越狱！”
schinese.name: ACH_17

schinese.description: “真想变成一只长着翅膀的鸟啊~”
schinese.name: ACH_18

schinese.description: “不过前面的光亮还在，这次应该不是幻觉了…”
schinese.name: ACH_19

schinese.description: “这世上总得有倒霉蛋，不是他们，就是我们。”
schinese.name: ACH_22

schinese.description: “看来都市传说并不都只是骇人的玩笑…”
schinese.name: ACH_2

schinese.description: “拳头的力量只是表象，我的力量来自内心…我可不是一个人在战斗。”
schinese.name: ACH_9

schinese.description: “第一眼我便爱上了你，直到你离开的那一天…”
schinese.name: ACH_7

schinese.description: “投身于黑暗之中，消失在阳光之下。”
schinese.name: ACH_20

schinese.description: “明明说好是三年，三年之后又三年…”
schinese.name: ACH_102

schinese.description: “…时间就是金钱，时间也是生命。”
schinese.name: ACH_103

schinese.description: “芬里尔…我总算找到你的藏身地了。接下来就该想办法找条路去那儿了…”
schinese.name: ACH_104

schinese.description: “但愿这不是个蠢主意，我可没工夫再去做一个‘救生圈’了。”
schinese.name: ACH_105

schinese.description: “啃啃！现在天亮了！你又从石头变回了自己！”
schinese.name: ACH_106

schinese.description: “哦~救命，跟你聊天可真是够‘愉快’的！”
schinese.name: ACH_107

schinese.description: “…没错，我就是你在找的那个‘芬里尔’。”
schinese.name: ACH_108

schinese.description: “我的身份从来只有一个，那就是一名‘爱国者’。”
schinese.name: ACH_109

schinese.description: “我答应过你，一定会救你出去…我从不食言。”
schinese.name: ACH_110

schinese.description: “既然那帮家伙把我称作‘芬里尔’…我想时至今日也该是挣脱锁链的时候了。”
schinese.name: ACH_111

schinese.description: “那是从管道出口照进来的月光…终点就在前面了。”
schinese.name: ACH_113

schinese.description: “你可以睁开眼睛了，我想你会喜欢这番景色的。”
schinese.name: ACH_114

schinese.description: “原来如此…看来你也能勉强算是一名‘驯兽师’了。”
schinese.name: ACH_115

schinese.description: “别担心，我们猫科天生都是‘爬树’的高手。”
schinese.name: ACH_116

schinese.description: “你总算是…做了个不那么天真的选择…？”
schinese.name: ACH_117

schinese.description: “至少在今晚，我会先帮一个好人，再抓一个坏人。”
schinese.name: ACH_118

schinese.description: “拳头造型的奖杯…这或许能用来砸橡果。不过可惜，监狱里并没有橡树…”
schinese.name: ACH_121

schinese.description: “这个长度、硬度、还有韧性…这应该是狼毛。”
schinese.name: ACH_122

schinese.description: “怎么样~金波，现在究竟是谁让谁‘失望’了呢~”
schinese.name: ACH_123
